root.label: Brookings analysis of US technology leadership window

events.label: Brookings analysis of US technology leadership window

slots.name: factory robots
slots.sentence: China leads the world in industrial robotics, with a rapidly growing installed base of over two million factory robots , and is outcompeting the U.S. in battery technology.

slots.name: solar farms
slots.sentence: China also leads in clean energy installations, controlling “ 11 of the top 15 largest solar farms globally ,” including Talatan Solar Park, which spans an area “ seven times the size of Manhattan .”

slots.name: American companies
slots.sentence: In artificial intelligence (AI) chip design, the U.S. remains the clear global leader.

slots.name: overseas tech workers
slots.sentence: Approximately two out of every three tech workers in Silicon Valley were born overseas.

slots.name: immigrant founding teams
slots.sentence: About half of tech startup founding teams in Silicon Valley include at least one immigrant co-founder .

slots.name: wind capacity multiplier
slots.sentence: A recent New York Times article noted that in 2025, “China installed three times as much wind power capacity as the rest of the world combined,” and that “all of the world’s six largest wind turbine manufacturers are Chinese.”

slots.name: Talatan area multiplier
slots.sentence: Talatan Solar Park, which spans an area “ seven times the size of Manhattan .”

slots.name: Chinese turbine manufacturers
slots.sentence: all of the world’s six largest wind turbine manufacturers are Chinese.

slots.name: R&D spending parity status
slots.sentence: China’s research and development spending is now at parity with America’s.

slots.name: US share of top 10 market cap companies
slots.sentence: Of the 10 publicly traded companies globally with the largest market capitalization , eight of them are American, and all of those are technology-focused.
